title: List endpoints bypass TransportListQuerySchema: unbounded pageSize, invalid page/UUID filters cause 500
test_evidence: list-query-validation.test.ts (failing-first: 9 failed before fix; 12 passed after); pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-transport test exit 0
notes: The 4 list handlers validate the querystring: resolvePaginationQuery (page>=1, integer, pageSize<=100) plus TransportListQuerySchema-based filter schemas; malformed UUID filters -> 400 instead of a PG cast 500. pageSize>100 -> 400 matches the gateway pagination-cap contract. Filter UUIDs use an any-version UUID pattern; isActive keeps its lenient parse.

title: Actor falls back to literal "transport" and alert acknowledge can be overwritten
